name: Noeud Digital
description: IA autonomisée coordonnant les attaques numériques multi-cibles avec une précision que l'intuition humaine ne pourrait égaler.

subject.archetype: Noeud Digital — Omni-Réseau Rare class reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek cybernetic combat suit with circuit pathways throughout fabric glowing bright cyan under stress, neural temple implant sparking from combat overload, holographic shield generators deployed on forearms, clean geometric lines contrasting with digital chaos with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Neural hacking deck with holographic wrist interface mid-operation showing active code streams, EMP emitter gauntlet crackling with charge creating visible blue arcs, data-spike dagger with glowing edge The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting all_own, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Tactical coordinator positioned between allied units with hands raised directing coordinated movements. Arms raised high in commanding gesture with focused targeted energy web radiating outward from chest in all directions, each thread connecting to different allied position across battlefield
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone with holographic displays shattering and glitching during battle, digital fortifications crumbling under enemy ICE attacks with visible code deterioration, server towers toppling and sparking, electric storms rippling through infrastructure
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Complete energy network visible with caster at glowing epicenter, energy flowing outward along dozens of channels simultaneously with each destination growing brighter as power arrives, Battlefield-wide glow connecting all friendly positions in visible network, ground cracking along energy pathways, sky briefly illuminated by massive network flash, Data streams arcing between floating terminals like electric whip lashes, holographic shields shattering into cascading pixel fragments dissolving mid-air, EMP waves visible as expanding blue rings distorting everything, server racks exploding in showers of sparks and circuit boards, electric arcs grounding through coolant puddles creating branching lightning
